profile.headline: Software Engineer III at Blue Origin
profile.summary:
I'm currently working as a full stack web developer. I work primarily with Java, Javascript, and many associated libraries/frameworks, but I enjoy learning new ways to solve problems and new languages suited to the task.

In my off time, I enjoy a bit of gaming, some good TV, books, dabbling in small creative projects, and various geeky endeavors that make it difficult to slip a reference past me.

positions.title: CTO and Co-Founder
positions.description: Going from 0-100 on a scalable web application to help users manage professional relationships with the aid of AI. Working with Node, Typescript, React, Groq, and so much more.

positions.title: Senior Software Development Engineer
positions.description: Full stack development working on a management interface for a dedicated appliance. Broadcom acquired Symantec and my role was unchanged.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · ExtJS · Angular · Full-Stack Development · JavaScript · PostgreSQL

positions.title: Senior Software Development Engineer
positions.description: Full stack development working on a management interface for a dedicated appliance.

company.name: Blue Coat Systems acquired by Symantec

positions.title: Developer
positions.description: Worked on the Staples web application, largely frontend Javascript.

positions.title: Java Developer
positions.description: Worked on enhancing and building on an internal web application using languages, libraries, and technologies such as Java, Seam, Hibernate, JPA, Javascript, jQuery, AngularJS, JSF, Richfaces, SQL, HTML, CSS, XML, JSON, XHTML, Spring, EWS and Exchange integegration, and more.

positions.title: Developer
positions.description: I worked with another student and developed a nutritional database application for a study to determine the nutritional intake of elementary students throughout the state. This application used a C# frontend that interfaced with a webcam to take pictures as well as an Access database backend to store information on student nutritional intake.
